title: Binance Launches USD Bank Transfer Solution for VIP and Non-VIP Corporate Users to Buy and Sell Crypto
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is thrilled to announce that we now offer corporate users to  buy and sell crypto with USD via SWIFT Bank Transfer  to KYB users from selected APAC and South Asia regions. This feature enables corporate users to seamlessly on and off ramp through Swift, and enjoy a limited-time special price! Notes:  Users are required to  complete KYB account verification . This service may be gradually rolled out to more regions. We will continue to provide more updates as we expand this service.  For More Information:  How to Buy Crypto with USD via Bank Transfer  on Binance? (Corporate Account) How to Sell Crypto to USD via Bank Transfer on Binance? (Corporate Account) Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-02-10 Note:  This announcement was updated on 2025-04-11 to clarify this feature covers both VIP and non-VIP users. Previously, it was updated on 2025-02-11 to update the eligible KYB regions for this feature.
